summary: Backend (Convex HTTP) + frontend sanity testing complete. 35/35 pytest cases pass against https://fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site/api including unauth 401, Arabic 400 for invalid phone, role-scoped read-only GETs for owner/acct/agent/dev. Frontend login screen renders Arabic RTL. DEV role dashboard works via injected session_token; OWNER/ACCT/AGENT are blocked by expired-subscription screen (/blocked) because test org org_test_1 has no active plan.

integration_issues.flow: Role dashboards for OWNER / ACCOUNTANT / FIELD_AGENT
integration_issues.issue: After injecting valid seeded bearer tokens into localStorage key 'session_token', the app routes all three roles to /blocked with 'انتهى اشتراك المؤسسة' (subscription expired). Only DEVELOPER reaches its dashboard (/dev). Need to seed org_test_1 with an active subscription/plan so the role tabs can actually render and be verified.

issues: Phone field accepts non-numeric country code: typing '123' into local part caused display '+123' in the country-code box; add client-side length/digit validation before submit (backend 400 still fires, so not a security issue, just UX).

action_items: Seed/renew subscription for test org org_test_1 so OWNER/ACCT/AGENT tokens can reach their dashboards (currently /blocked). Likely means setting org.plan_id + plan_expires_at (or equivalent) to a future date in Convex DB.
(Optional UX) Tighten phone validation on login so country code field only accepts the predefined prefix and local number length matches 9 digits before enabling CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: convex/http.ts statusFor() uses Arabic substring matching to pick HTTP codes (مصرح→401, صلاحية→403, غير موجود→404). Works but fragile; a typed error tag would be more robust.
src/api.ts throws generic Error('حدث خطأ غير متوقع') when detail is not a string — fine but loses the original status code for callers.

success_rate.frontend: 25% (1/4 role dashboards reachable; login screen renders)

seed_data_creation: None. Only read-only GETs executed against org_test_1 with seeded tokens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Convex API is healthy at https://fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site/api — reuse /app/backend/tests/test_convex_api.py for regression. For frontend role testing, inject token with: localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('<token>')) then reload. AsyncStorage web backend = localStorage, JSON-stringified. Tokens: test_token_dev/owner/acct/agent. Currently only DEV reaches dashboard; the other three hit /blocked (subscription expired) — must be fixed in Convex seed before frontend role flows can be verified.
rca_of_issue: RCA for /blocked redirect: convex query api.extra.me returns user+org; _layout logic routes to /blocked when org has no active plan or plan_expires_at <= now. The seeded org org_test_1 was created without (or with an already-expired) subscription, so every non-DEV role hits the subscription-expired guard. Mitigation: in Convex dashboard or via a dev mutation, set org_test_1 plan to any active plan with plan_expires_at = now + 1 year, or run a seed script that creates/attaches an active trial. DEV role bypasses the check because it's a platform role not tied to org subscription.
